name: Citizens’ Assembly Limburg (Limburg, Netherlands)
content: Problems and Purpose Background History and Context Organizing, Supporting, and Funding Entities Participant Recruitment and Selection Methods and Tools Used What Went On: Process, Interaction, and Participation 6 themes were identified at the citizens' assembly. It was a strange mix of environmental topics, health care and culture (e.g. a ‘health care bar’; it seems that one later got dubbed ‘quality of life’). Afterwards a second meeting was held with project groups each covering one of the six topics (25 January 2019; N=100). Influence, Outcomes, and Effects The six groups had their own timelines and presented their results to the Provincial governments on 20 June 2019. The results are advisory, though a board is installed to ensure that the advice is taken seriously (consisting of two citizens, one member of the coalition and one member of the opposition). It remains to be seen, however, to what extent this has a beneficial impact. Analysis and Lessons Learned See Also References External Links Notes This entry is based on the POLITICIZE dataset.
